title: Data race when several threads calls methods on the same object and emit deferred signals on it
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: v4.7.beta.custom_build [6d6e822c6]

### System information

Godot v4.7.beta (6d6e822c6) - EndeavourOS #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Thu, 23 Apr 2026 06:57:02 +0000 on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - Mesa Intel(R) UHD Graphics 630 (CFL GT2) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-9300H CPU @ 2.40GHz (8 threads) - 15.49 GiB memory - PulseAudio (44100 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

`GDScriptFunction::call` calls `Variant::ObjData::ref_pointer`(and it calls `Object::_has_ancestry`) on the object it is called on. While it is being called it is possible that the main thread flushes deferred calls, because of this `Object::emit_signalp` could be called on the same object at the same time the call is being made, so if it happened it will write to `_emitting` and read from `_ancestry` on the same object causing data race.

If what I found is correct it is mainly an issue because they are bit-fields that are near each other.

Also I guess it can also happen if other threads call `Object::emit_signalp` directly. I don't remember if it safe... Actually what I'm thinking it sets `_emitting` so it is unsafe to call it from different threads at the same time.

Thinking about it, you can also emit the signal yourself on the main thread on the same instance and the data race can still happen, calling deferred emit is just a shortcut to the main thread.

Method that caused data race:
```gdscript
signal finished_subprofile(time_spent: int, thread: int)

func call_shared(count: int, thread: int) -> int:
    var time_before: int = Time.get_ticks_msec()
    var sum := 0
    for i in count:
        sum += get_instance_increment()
    #finished_subprofile.emit.call_deferred(Time.get_ticks_msec() - time_before, thread) this caused data race too
    emit_signal.call_deferred(&"finished_subprofile", Time.get_ticks_msec() - time_before, thread)
    return sum

func get_instance_increment() -> int:
    return 1
```
